title: Core RDK Entertainment Platform
description: RDKE provides a flexible software foundation for entertainment platforms, built on reusable components, consistent APIs, and hardware abstraction. RDK8 extends this foundation with Firebolt Connect, enabling standardized app delivery, earlier validation, and smoother integration across RDK-powered devices.

why.title: Why choose RDK-E?
why.description: RDK-E standardizes core platform functionality while allowing operators, OEMs, and technology partners to focus on creating differentiated user experiences and services. The platform provides a layered architecture that improves portability, maintainability, and time-to-market.
cards: Open and reusable
An open, modular platform built from reusable components that can be configured across STB entertainment platforms.
Consistent interfaces
Common APIs and services that help applications work consistently across diverse device platforms.
Hardware portability
Layered abstractions that reduce hardware coupling and simplify integration across SoCs and vendor platforms.
Faster delivery
Reusable platform capabilities that help operators, OEMs, and technology partners focus on differentiated experiences.

benefits.title: Key benefits of RDK8
cards: Earlier app validation
Firebolt Connect enables earlier validation of app onboarding, lifecycle behavior, and platform integration.
Scalable app delivery
A standardized model supports web and native apps through containerized delivery across the RDK ecosystem.
Lower integration risk
Early testing on real implementations helps partners identify performance, stability, and compatibility issues sooner.
Ecosystem readiness
A shared release direction helps operators, OEMs, silicon partners, and developers coordinate adoption and planning.

architecture.title: Everything in the Core RDK platform
layers: Firebolt Connect, web and native apps, standardized onboarding, and app lifecycle experiences.
Thunder services, entertainment services, media, DRM, device management, and platform capabilities.
Real hardware validation across SoCs, drivers, HAL implementations, Linux integration, and platform-specific OSS.
cards: Core RDK components
The middleware-layer components that deliver a single, consistent implementation of core RDK-E device functionality.
Northbound APIs
Standardized APIs the middleware exposes upward to the application layer, giving apps consistent access to device capabilities via Thunder and Firebolt.
Southbound APIs
The Hardware Abstraction Layer (HAL) between middleware and the platform layer — standardized interfaces that abstract hardware differences.
Hardware specification
Reference hardware requirements and device specifications defined for the Entertainment OS platform.
